hooks.text: HMS Terror was found with its hatches closed and anchor deployed.
129 men vanished into the ice when Sir John Franklin sailed.
Two frozen ships spent over a century hidden in the Arctic.

title: Why Were HMS Terror's Hatches Closed When Found? 😳
description: Discover the chilling mystery of Sir John Franklin's lost 1845 Arctic expedition and the pristine wreck of HMS Terror.
